charge_port.notes: Estimated: EV Specifications lists CCS1 for the North American 2023-25 Solterra; Subaru (Oct 2025) says 2023-2025 owners need a NACS adapter and only the 2026 has a NACS port; Toyota says its 2023-25 twin has a CCS1 port.

supercharger_access.notes: Subaru of America (22 Oct 2025): owners of 2023-2025 Solterra can purchase a Genuine Subaru Accessory Fast Charging Adapter (NACS); all Solterra owners have access to 25,000+ Tesla Superchargers.
Drive Tesla Canada: Subaru says all Solterra EV owners can access 25,000+ Superchargers in Canada and the US; 2023-2025 owners will buy the NACS adapter from Subaru dealers.

wheels.notes: 2023 US Premium AWD page; no 2024 Premium page opened.
US Limited AWD: 20 in; applied to Canada.
